digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today closed with concrete queue cleanup and a Denver day-two stability review, while the four priority follow-ups remain open. Thursday is meeting-heavy, with two afternoon overlaps that need coverage decisions.

items.label: Lock Denver's day-two controls and next owners
items.detail: Thiago's standup update put Denver day-two feedback and stability first, while Salesforce support ownership, AI validation, and the Austin and Houston readiness review remained active. Confirm the evidence, owners, and escalation triggers before the next rollout decisions.

items.label: Close the Sara and Contigo clarification loop
items.detail: Confirm what remains unclear after Mar's additional context and make sure the project team is aligned on a recommendation before the November 6 stakeholder checkpoint.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: The short follow-up survey remains open and has been carrying since October 23. Use Thursday's protected work block to finish it.

items.label: Shape the Salesforce release priorities for Sprint 22
items.detail: Select the release-review items that need Product roadmap decisions or IT follow-up before Thursday's 2:00 PM Sprint 22 prioritization call.

items.label: TRACE minor improvements request was cancelled
items.detail: Licelot confirmed the request could be closed because the remaining updates will move into process controls or a broader TRACE iteration.

items.label: Four Retentions CoE requests were cancelled
items.detail: Santiago confirmed that Unresponsive WF CLR, CLR Visibility, Retentions and Contracts taskset Automation, and the Launch Refund taskset update could be removed from the on-hold queue.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Laura 1:1 and protected work
items.detail: Use the morning sequence to clear Laura's highest-value roadblocks and finish the preparation needed for the afternoon prioritization block.

items.label: 1:30-3:00 PM - Project Coords, Sprint 22, and Sara overlap
items.detail: Project Coords starts at 1:30 PM, the Sprint 22 call at 2:00 PM, and the Sara 1:1 at 2:30 PM. Decide whether to move the 1:1 or leave the prioritization call with a named decision owner.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Weekly meeting and Amazon Connect standup conflict
items.detail: Set coverage for the double-booked block and secure the rollout readout, including Austin and Houston readiness, from the session Jean does not attend.
